## 1. Right-Sizing Guide

### Common Mistakes (Ranked by Cost Impact)

| 4 | Staying on a hyperscaler (AWS/GCP/Azure) for steady-state workloads | 2–6× premium vs. specialized GPU clouds | Migrate to Vast.ai / Together / RunPod |

## 2. Reducing Idle Time

### The Problem
A GPU running at 30% utilization for 24 hrs costs the same as one at 100% for 7.2 hrs. At $1.73/hr (H100-SXM, Vast.ai), 70% idle = **$3.50/hr wasted** per GPU.

### Strategies (Ordered by Impact)

| **Schedule on/off** for batch jobs | Cron / Terraform to spin up at 02:00, down at 14:00 | 10 × $1.73 × 10 hrs × 30 = **$5,190/mo** | Low |

| **Batch inference** instead of real-time | Accumulate requests, run in 15-min windows | Cuts GPU-hours by 50–70% for <100 req/min workloads | Medium |
| **Multi-tenant GPU sharing** (MIG, MPS) | 7× A100 MIG slices on 1 GPU for small models | 1× $1.14 replaces 7× $1.14 → **$7.98/hr saved** | High |
| **Right-size VRAM** (see §1) | 80 GB → 40 GB A100 for models <30 GB | 10 × ($1.14 − $0.54) × 730 = **$4,380/mo** | Low |
| **Time purchases to price dips** | GB200 dropped 16.2% MoM; RTX-4090 down 9.5%; H200 predicted to hit $1.75 by Feb 2027 | Deferring a 4× GB200 rental 3 months: 4 × ($9.38 − ~$7.50) × 730 ≈ **$5,530 saved** | Low |
